# Install

## Requirements

- Python **3.10 or newer**
- Chromium, installed through Playwright (below)
- `ffmpeg`, optional but recommended

## The package

```bash
pip install git+https://github.com/tungufoss/instagram-archiver.git
python -m playwright install chromium
```

The second line is not optional: the tool drives a real Chromium window, and
Playwright needs to download it once.

::: {.callout-note title="Not on PyPI"}

Install from the Git repository, as above. Add `@v0.3.0` to pin a release:
`pip install git+https://github.com/tungufoss/instagram-archiver.git@v0.3.0`

:::

## ffmpeg

Instagram sometimes delivers a video's picture and sound as two separate
files. With `ffmpeg` present they are merged losslessly; without it such a
video may end up silent.

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Windows

```bash
winget install Gyan.FFmpeg
```

### macOS

```bash
brew install ffmpeg
```

### Debian / Ubuntu

```bash
sudo apt install ffmpeg
```

:::

## Check it worked

```bash
instagram-archiver --version
```

## From a clone, for development

```bash
git clone https://github.com/tungufoss/instagram-archiver.git
cd instagram-archiver
pip install -e ".[dev]"
python -m playwright install chromium
pytest
```
